name: uml-mcp
description: Generate UML and other diagrams through MCP
long_description: UML-MCP renders UML, Mermaid, D2, Graphviz, BPMN, C4, TikZ and the rest of the Kroki catalog from plain diagram source. It runs locally over stdio and returns a shareable render URL, inline image data, or a saved file when you configure an output directory.

tools.name: generate_uml
tools.description: Render one diagram from source code and return its URL, inline image, or saved file path.

tools.name: generate_uml_batch
tools.description: Render several independent diagrams in one call, keeping partial failures isolated.

tools.name: validate_uml
tools.description: Check diagram type, format, size, and syntax locally without rendering.

tools.name: list_diagram_types
tools.description: Discover supported diagram types with their renderer backend and output formats.

output_dir.title: Diagram output directory
output_dir.description: Optional. Leave empty to get render URLs and inline images only. Pick a folder to also save diagram files there; that folder becomes the write sandbox.

kroki_server.title: Kroki server URL
kroki_server.description: Rendering backend. Point this at a self-hosted Kroki instance to keep diagram source off the public service.

plantuml_server.title: PlantUML server URL
plantuml_server.description: PlantUML fallback used when Kroki cannot render a PlantUML-family diagram.
